dog.description_text:
Ernie is an adorable, playful kitten who is excited and ready to learn about life!

Ernie is a curious little guy, and he has yet to discover a toy, or a string, that he has not found ways to enjoy.

When playtime is over, Ernie is more than happy to curl up for pets and cuddles. Ernie is often found spending time with his littermate, Bert, but he would also be content with a loving human lap to recharge in. Ernie is FeLV-positive, but that doesn’t stop this sweet little guy from wanting to play, live and love like any other kitten would.

Ernie is ready to find a loving home where he can continue growing, playing and enjoying all that life has to offer! Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more about him.

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: ERNIE
